summary: 10.0.35.06 Comprehensive Desktop Parity Release - Full 13-Defect Resolution: Saved Reports recovery, Item Master import/export & concurrency, Master Data category workflows, Bank & Expense filters, Bank Statement history drawer & delete flow, Data Import Studio bank auto-map, Reminder Center 100% desktop parity, Global Audit Trail badges, Settings branding images authoritative sync, Stock Register refresh/export, Customer & Supplier 360 navigation routing, Purchase Register SheetJS Excel/PDF exports.
highlights: 1. Saved Reports Tab 3: Robust JSON and REPORT_V2 parsing with default presets fallback and synchronized dropdown loading.
2. Item Master: Fixed importItemsExcel() routing, implemented client-side SheetJS 13-column Excel export, fixed concurrency rowVersion error on save, locked openingStock on edit.
3. Master Data: Resolved modal ID and function mismatches, added ROLE category protection, enabled Rename and Deactivate/Reactivate toggles.
4. Bank & Expense Entry: Added BANK DEPOSIT, BANK WITHDRAWAL, CONTRA_IN, CONTRA_OUT, and EXPENSE to filter so data is visible; bound dropdowns to master lookups.
5. Bank Statement: Resolved active BANK_ACCOUNT lookup by code, implemented Desktop-parity 2-step batch deletion dialog with impact metrics.
6. Browse Statements Drawer: Added statement history drawer with search, status filters, date range, table, open and delete actions.
7. Data Import Studio: Scanned candidate header rows 0-15 for banking sheets, expanded aliases for all banking columns, relaxed preflight required fields with smart fallbacks.
8. Reminder Center: 100% Desktop ReminderCenter.fxml parity with 4 KPI cards, full filter bar, 7 columns, detail drawer, Add/Edit/Snooze modals, and backend /api/insights/reminders CRUD.
9. Global Audit Trail: Semantic colored action badges (DELETE/REJECT/CANCEL red, PAYMENT/FINANCIAL blue, DOCUMENT purple, EMAIL/COMM teal, CREATE/APPROVE green) and cyan View action.
10. Settings Branding: Removed all dummy fallback images, implemented authoritative sync for all 5 canonical keys, added server-side DELETE on removal.
11. Stock Register: Wired Refresh button to forceRefresh = true; added client-side SheetJS 11-column Excel export.
12. CRM/HRM 360 Navigation: Fixed navigateTo routing method in NavigationRouter.js and PartyController.js, restoring instant access to Customer 360° and Supplier 360°.
13. Purchase Register Export: Implemented client-side SheetJS Excel export (13 standard columns + summary row) and PDF export, added Export toolbar buttons.
